description: This file defines a templated C++ class 'TlsEnabled' for managing TLS configuration in WebSocket connections, including setting certificate files, initializing SSL contexts, and handling verification.

classes.name: TlsEnabled
classes.description: A templated class providing TLS setup and management for WebSocket connections, including certificate handling and SSL context initialization.

methods.name: setCertFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the TLS certificate.

methods.name: setKeyFileName
methods.description: Sets the filename for the private key.

methods.name: setCAFileNames
methods.description: Sets the list of CA certificate filenames.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes TLS handling by setting the TLS init handler.

methods.name: setAuthenticationState
methods.description: Determines if the TLS connection was successfully established and updates the result accordingly.

methods.name: onTlsInit
methods.description: Creates and configures the SSL context for a TLS connection.

methods.name: loadCertificateAuthorities
methods.description: Loads CA certificates into the SSL context from specified files or defaults.
